run_attribution_benchmark: run the pointing game benchmark for all attribution methods across datasets and architectures
run_ExperimentExecutor: run an ExperimentExecutor to evaluate a single attribution method on a dataset with a model
create_Experiment: create an Experiment object with a method, architecture, and dataset for the pointing game benchmark
aggregate_ExperimentExecutor: aggregate pointing game results across all images and classes using the ExperimentExecutor
convert_saliency_to_point: convert a saliency map tensor to x,y point coordinates using argmax
